cat << 'PYEOF' | python3
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 12,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 9,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

# Okabe-Ito color-blind friendly
COLOR_PERMG = '#0072B2'
COLOR_MMCT = '#D55E00'
COLOR_PENDING = '#AAAAAA'

# Data
alphas_complete = [0.00, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00]
alphas_pending = [0.05, 0.60]

permg_rates = [0.000, 0.000, 0.000, 0.083, 0.833, 0.750]
mmct_rates =  [0.000, 0.125, 0.438, 0.583, 0.792, 0.813]
permg_n =     [24,    8,     16,    24,    24,    32]
mmct_n =      [24,    8,     16,    24,    24,    32]

# Wilson binomial CI
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0:
        return (0, 0)
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    centre = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    spread = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    lo = max(0, centre - spread)
    hi = min(1, centre + spread)
    return (lo, hi)

permg_ci = [wilson_ci(p, n) for p, n in zip(permg_rates, permg_n)]
mmct_ci = [wilson_ci(p, n) for p, n in zip(mmct_rates, mmct_n)]

permg_lo = [ci[0]*100 for ci in permg_ci]
permg_hi = [ci[1]*100 for ci in permg_ci]
permg_err_lo = [r*100 - lo for r, lo in zip(permg_rates, permg_lo)]
permg_err_hi = [hi - r*100 for r, hi in zip(permg_rates, permg_hi)]

mmct_lo = [ci[0]*100 for ci in mmct_ci]
mmct_hi = [ci[1]*100 for ci in mmct_ci]
mmct_err_lo = [r*100 - lo for r, lo in zip(mmct_rates, mmct_lo)]
mmct_err_hi = [hi - r*100 for r, hi in zip(mmct_rates, mmct_hi)]

# Figure: 2 panels
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4), sharey=True)

# === Left Panel: PermG (bar chart) ===
bar_width = 0.07
bars = ax1.bar(alphas_complete, [r*100 for r in permg_rates],
               width=bar_width, color=COLOR_PERMG, alpha=0.85, zorder=2,
               label='PermG (BH FDR corrected)')
# Error bars on top of bars
ax1.errorbar(alphas_complete, [r*100 for r in permg_rates],
             yerr=[permg_err_lo, permg_err_hi],
             fmt='none', ecolor='#333333', elinewidth=1.0, capsize=3, zorder=3)

# Pending positions
for ap in alphas_pending:
    ax1.bar(ap, 0, width=bar_width, color='none', edgecolor=COLOR_PENDING,
            linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2, zorder=2)
    ax1.text(ap, 2, '?', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom', color=COLOR_PENDING)

# Step annotation
ax1.annotate('', xy=(0.74, 80), xytext=(0.52, 12),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#444444', lw=1.3,
                           connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.2'))
ax1.text(0.63, 42, 'step\ntransition', fontsize=8, ha='center',
         color='#555555', fontstyle='italic')

# Note on alpha=1.00
ax1.annotate('cross-arch.\nvariance', xy=(1.00, 75), xytext=(0.85, 55),
             fontsize=7, color='#777777', fontstyle='italic',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#999999', lw=0.7))

ax1.set_xlabel(r'Contamination ratio ($\alpha$)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Detection rate (%)')
ax1.set_title('(a) Permutation Granger causality', fontsize=11, pad=8)
ax1.set_xlim(-0.08, 1.12)
ax1.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax1.set_xticks([0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00])
ax1.set_xticklabels(['0', '0.10', '0.25', '0.50', '0.75', '1.00'])
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

# === Right Panel: MMCT weighted_pair (line + scatter) ===
ax2.plot(alphas_complete, [r*100 for r in mmct_rates], 'o-',
         color=COLOR_MMCT, markersize=7, markerfacecolor=COLOR_MMCT,
         markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0, zorder=3,
         label='MMCT weighted pair')
# CI band
ax2.fill_between(alphas_complete, mmct_lo, mmct_hi,
                 color=COLOR_MMCT, alpha=0.15, zorder=1)

# Pending positions
for ap in alphas_pending:
    ax2.plot(ap, -5, 'o', color=COLOR_PENDING, markersize=7,
             markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=COLOR_PENDING,
             markeredgewidth=1.2, clip_on=True)
    # Small "?" label above
    ax2.text(ap, 3, '?', fontsize=8, ha='center', va='bottom', color=COLOR_PENDING)

# Gradual onset annotation
ax2.annotate('gradual onset\nfrom ' + r'$\alpha$=0.10', xy=(0.10, 12.5),
             xytext=(0.28, 28), fontsize=8, color='#555555',
             fontstyle='italic',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#555555', lw=0.8))

ax2.set_xlabel(r'Contamination ratio ($\alpha$)')
ax2.set_title('(b) MMCT weighted-pair consensus', fontsize=11, pad=8)
ax2.set_xlim(-0.08, 1.12)
ax2.set_xticks([0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00])
ax2.set_xticklabels(['0', '0.10', '0.25', '0.50', '0.75', '1.00'])
ax2.legend(loc='upper left', framealpha=0.9, edgecolor='#CCCCCC')

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=2.5)

# Save
outdir = '/root/autodl-tmp/distrib_canary_collapse/artifacts/dual_track_figure/'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig(outdir + 'dual_track_dose_response.pdf')
plt.savefig(outdir + 'dual_track_dose_response.png')
plt.close()
print(f'Saved PDF and PNG to {outdir}')

# Verify file sizes
for ext in ['pdf', 'png']:
    fpath = outdir + f'dual_track_dose_response.{ext}'
    sz = os.path.getsize(fpath)
    print(f'  {ext.upper()}: {sz:,} bytes')
PYEOF
